summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Dev0 v1.5 covering: (1) Sandboxed Browser IndexedDB + Docker Container Workspace Isolation without self-source exposure, (2) Zero-PII Email Redaction & Google Sign-In + Owner Passphrase Claim with 3-tier RBAC (Owner/Admin/User), (3) Real Per-Chat Debug Telemetry & Zero-Seeded Token Accounting, (4) Provider Model Catalog with Yellow Search Highlighting & LM Studio/Ollama Custom Endpoint Fetch, (5) Hidden .agents/<name>/ Sub-Agent Workspaces, Cron Scheduler, Pause/Sleep Mode, Explicit finish_task Tool, and Interactive Workflow Graph Card with Direct Relay Submission, and (6) Automated Branch & PR Creation for Netlify CI/CD.
